name: option-universe-300b-rank
notes: ADR-0235 amendment (2026-10-12, owner request): the SECOND 300. Same ranking as run-option-universe-300-rank.json (20-session chain_volume sum, top 300) but excluding all 417 stocks already pulled (configs/option_universe_pulled_417.json = stock_universe.json + option_universe_300.json), writing configs/option_universe_300b.json. Reads the same stored activity (option-activity, sessions 2026-09-04..2026-10-02); no new acquisition. The 300th name trades about 36k option contracts in 20 sessions, so these chains will be thinner than the first 300's. Run from children/index_options: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-option-universe-300b-rank.json --asof 2026-10-03.

chain_volume.notes: Per-underlying, per-session total option volume (and count of contracts that traded) from the activity pull. A symbol missing from a session did not trade that day. The root is the machine store root (the established convention for onboarding store paths in these configs); change it per machine.

rank.notes: Exclusion: the 417 stocks already pulled, read from configs/option_universe_pulled_417.json. DXYZ stays excluded by name (closed-end fund).

params.source: TrailingRank over 20 sessions of chain_volume (option-activity), top 300 excluding option_universe_pulled_417.json

universe_file.notes: expect counts the two top-level entries, tickers and ranking. The pull source config reads `tickers` from this file.
